# Aagon

> > Aagon delivers ACMP, a comprehensive Unified Endpoint Management and IT operations platform designed for secure, compliant device and software management across enterprises.

Aagon is a German IT management software company specializing in ACMP (Ausgezeichnetes Client Management), an enterprise platform for endpoint management, asset inventory, patch management, and license optimization. The platform serves public sector, healthcare, industrial, and education sectors with emphasis on DSGVO and NIS-2 compliance.

## Key Topics

- ACMP (Ausgezeichnetes Client Management)
- Unified Endpoint Management (UEM)
- Patch Management
- License Management
- Asset Management
- Device Management
- Software Distribution
- IT Infrastructure
- Security & Compliance
- Digital Sovereignty
- Windows Update Management
- OS Deployment
- Multi-Tenancy
- Microsoft Intune Integration
- DSGVO & NIS-2 Compliance
